5. Callouts & Advisory Alerts

Semantic advisory banners used throughout checklists for important tips, warnings, and rules.

Helpful Tip: Slot Booking Timing

Appointment slots on the Sarathi Parivahan portal open daily at 10:00 AM IST. Log in 5 minutes early to secure your preferred date.

Mandatory Rule: Carry Physical Originals

You must carry original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies to the RTO. Digital copies in DigiLocker are accepted for road inspections, but initial granting requires original physical verification.

Anti-Fraud Warning: Never Pay Middlemen

The statutory government fee is strictly ₹200. Do not pay unauthorized agents or touts outside the RTO premise.

Instant Online Verification Eligible

Applicants with Aadhaar-linked mobile numbers can complete the entire application and online learner test from home without visiting the RTO.

6. Step List & Checklist Item Components

Numbered steps connected by vertical lines, with interactive completion toggles and collapsible document helpers.

Procedure Steps

Submit Online Application via Sarathi Parivahan

Official Sarathi Portal (parivahan.gov.in)

Visit the official Ministry of Road Transport portal. Select Gujarat, choose 'Apply for Learner Licence', and enter your Aadhaar number for instant e-KYC identity verification.

2

Upload Documents & Fee Payment (₹200)

Online Payment Gateway (Debit/UPI)

Upload scanned self-attested copies of your Age Proof (Aadhaar/10th Marksheet) and Address Proof. Pay the ₹200 statutory government fee via SBI ePay or UPI.

Transaction Receipt Mandatory

Save and print your e-receipt (Form 2) and acknowledgment slip. You must carry this if visiting the RTO.
3

Appear for Online Computerized Traffic Rule Test

Online from Home (or RTO Sub-Center)

Take the 15-question multiple choice test on road traffic signs, signals, and driver duties. You need 11 correct answers to pass. Your digital learner licence is generated immediately upon passing.

Required Documents

Click checkbox to mark done. Click "What is this?" to expand help.

Proof of Age (Aadhaar Card, Birth Certificate, or 10th Marksheet)
MandatoryOriginal + 1 self-attested photocopy
Proof of Current Address (Electricity Bill or Rent Agreement)
MandatoryOriginal + 1 photocopy
Form 1A Medical Fitness Certificate
If applicableOriginal doctor signed certificate

7. Accordion & FAQ List

Accessible accordion headers with 24px plus/minus icons, smooth height transitions, and one-open-at-a-time control.

Built-in FaqList Component

Yes! Under Gujarat's faceless e-KYC service on the Parivahan Sarathi portal, you can complete Aadhaar e-KYC, pay the ₹200 fee, and take the online learner test from home. You only visit the physical RTO for the permanent driving track test after 30 days.

The official fee is strictly ₹200 (₹150 application processing + ₹50 computerized test fee) under Rule 32 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules. Never pay extra to middlemen or agents.

A Learner's Licence is valid for exactly 6 months (180 days) across all states and Union Territories in India. You can apply for a permanent licence 30 days after your LL is issued.

Custom Accordion with Multi-Open

Under the revised Motor Vehicles Act, showing documents via DigiLocker or mParivahan is legally equivalent to physical original documents during road traffic checks.

You have a 1-year grace period after expiry to renew your driving licence without having to re-take the driving test.
